caption: The video captures a large iridescent soap bubble above a pale sandy beach, its thin lower tail reaching toward the ground while green, tree-covered hills and a clear blue sky fill the background. The bubble's outline slowly deforms, the protruding left lobe retracting rightward as the upper dome rises and rounds out. Bright star-shaped sun glints drift across the thin film, and a scattered cluster near the top converges into a dominant point of light. Rainbow-colored interference bands shift hue and position as the curvature changes. The lower tail stays at roughly the same place near the sand. The horizon remains fixed, so the changing shape appears in the bubble rather than the camera.
